description: The Metal Pig in Chinese astrology: personality, Metal element traits, 1971 and 2031 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Metal Pig is the Pig born in a Metal year, one of five versions of the twelfth animal. It combines the Pig's generosity with Metal's qualities. Metal Pig years between 1924 and 2044 are 1971 and 2031. The Pig's fixed element is Water.

sections.heading: The Metal Pig personality
paragraphs: Metal generates Water, and the Pig's fixed element is Water, so a Metal year is said to strengthen and supply this warm-hearted animal, adding determination and backbone to its natural generosity. Metal Pigs are often described as strong, honest and resilient, with clear goals and the persistence to reach them. They tend to be loyal friends and principled colleagues. Their generosity is matched by a sense of fairness and a willingness to stand firm. The supporting flow gives them confidence, though readings mention a tendency towards stubbornness, overcommitment and indulgence when the work is done. Beneath the strength, they remain soft-hearted, easily moved by others' hardship and quick to offer practical help, often before anyone has thought to ask.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: Metal Pig at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Metal is usually linked with discipline, precision and principled leadership. Metal-year people are often described as the ones who set standards, cut through confusion and finish what they start, which suits law, engineering, finance, surgery, editing and any role that values exactness. They tend to work well alone and lead by example. The traditional caution is inflexibility: a Metal stem can dismiss ideas that arrive untidily, so practising curiosity before judgement usually makes them better leaders.

A Metal Pig keeps its good nature yet adds noticeable grit. Business ownership, law, construction management, wine and food trade and sports administration are typical fits, as sincerity backed by determination wins respect there. It pursues goals doggedly, says exactly what it thinks and will defend colleagues who are treated unfairly. Few people doubt where they stand with it. In love the Metal Pig is loyal, passionate and frank, giving its whole heart once it commits. It hopes for an equally direct partner who keeps their word. Tension tends to come from stubbornness and a long memory: once hurt, it may hold onto the grievance well after the other person believes it settled.

sections.heading: Metal Pig years and dates
paragraphs: The table from 1924 to 2044 holds 2 Metal Pig years: 1971, starting Jan 27 and 2031, starting Jan 23. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1971 anyone born before Jan 27 is a Metal Dog, not a Metal Pig. It takes sixty years for the Metal stem and the Pig branch to coincide again, which is why the same pairing marks grandparents and grandchildren rather than siblings. Every Metal Pig year is Yin, matching the Pig's own polarity.

In the sexagenary calendar this is the Xin-Hai year, the Metal stem Xin with the Pig's branch Hai. Births just before each new year fall in the Metal Dog year (before January 27, 1971) and the Metal Dog year (before January 23, 2031), and births in the weeks after each Metal Pig year ends belong to the Water Rat. The new year itself fell on a Wednesday in 1971 and Thursday in 2031.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Metal Pig
paragraphs: Metal Pigs usually grow by staying open to compromise. Their strength serves them well, but treating every disagreement as a test of principle strains relationships. Listening carefully to opposing views, then deciding, often produces better outcomes. Metal Pigs may also need to balance hard work with genuine rest, rather than swinging between effort and indulgence. Sharing feelings directly, not just through generous acts, deepens close bonds. Roles combining integrity and care suit them. When strength is joined with flexibility, Metal Pigs become admired and trusted figures in their communities. Their honesty is an asset when it is gentle.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Metal Pig shares the Pig's San He trine with the Rabbit and Goat (the Wood trine), its Liu He bond with the Tiger, and its Liu Chong clash with the Snake. The element adds a second layer: another Metal sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Metal in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Metal Pig years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1971 (from January 27, 1971) and 2031 (from January 23, 2031). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Metal Pig's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Metal and the Pig's fixed element is Water; in the five-element cycles metal generates Water. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Metal Pig?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rabbit and Goat (San He) and the Tiger (Liu He). The Snake is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Metal Pig called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Xin-Hai. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Metal stem Xin, followed by its earthly branch, here Hai for the Pig, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Metal Pig different from other Pigs?
faq.answer: All Pigs share generosity, sincerity and warmth. The Metal year element changes the tone: metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets.
